brief.acceptanceEvidence: All compared responses and downstream decisions must agree exactly. Retain any mismatch.
brief.adoptionEvidence: None. Voluntary adoption, contracts, revenue and profitability remain unestablished.
brief.beneficiariesHypothesis: Hypothesis: experimental teams with repeated configuration decisions. No customers established.
brief.constraints: Public synthetic inputs only; fixed bounded integer arithmetic; no model, network or payment calls.
brief.constructionPlan: Declare the class, calibrate the basis, freeze the instrument, then check unused configurations.
brief.costHypothesis: Unknown monetary cost. Count abstract calibration observations and reuse queries separately.
brief.financingHypothesis: Unknown construction funding, working capital and timing; no budget or purchase is approved.
brief.objective: Qualify a finite synthetic experimentation platform while preserving existing services.
brief.problemFamily: Configuration response prediction, feasible-design screening and ranking candidate designs.
brief.proposedConstruction: Construct a calibrated low-interaction representation of a synthetic binary response system.
brief.restrictiveAssumption: Each new configuration requires an unrelated full measurement.
brief.reusePlan: Reuse the frozen coefficients for a distinct threshold-screening and ranking task without recalibration.
brief.scopeAssumptions: The synthetic world must respect the declared interaction-order bound. Physical qualification is absent.
brief.title: Build the Next Discovery Lab
brief.unmetNeed: Explore many possible configurations without repeating a full response census for every decision.
brief.valueHypothesis: Unknown. A smaller calibration catalogue is not evidence of accepted value or superior engineering.
